payments.emptyText: As soon as you pay for a course, its reference, amount and date show up here — and stay there once the course is over.
payments.errorBody: The read stopped before it came back: network down, or database unreachable. Your payments are still recorded, it's the display that's missing. Run the read again.
payments.truthBody: A refund isn't triggered here: it goes through the payment provider that took the money. And the amount that counts is the one recomputed server-side at the time of the charge, not the one shown on the row.

rysmoMemory.consentIntro: Memory is on by default: your {{tutor}} remembers your conversations so it can answer you more personally (your goals, your topics, the things you want to strengthen). Nothing is shared — you can switch it off, or wipe everything, whenever you like.
rysmoMemory.memoryOn: On — it tailors its answers to your journey
rysmoMemory.disabledText: Memory is off. Turn it on above so it can get to know you.
rysmoMemory.noMemoriesText: It has no memories yet. Chat with it a little and come back here.
rysmoMemory.resetHint: Wiping is immediate and does not go through support.
rysmoMemory.interestsSubtitle: Based on the content you consume (articles read, audio/video, time spent).
rysmoMemory.journeySubtitle: Your {{tutor}} always leans on your progress to guide you, even without memory.
rysmoMemory.confirmText: It will forget everything it learned from your conversations — summary, topics, areas to strengthen. Your courses and progress are untouched. This cannot be undone.
rysmoMemory.toastResetSuccess: Memory wiped. It starts from scratch.
rysmoMemory.clearBody: Clearing is immediate and doesn't go through support. The memory rebuilds from your later exchanges only.
rysmoMemory.renameNote: The name changes for you only, and it changes everywhere — tab, header, first bubble. “{{app}}” stays the name of the application.
rysmoMemory.renameHintCustom: You can go back to “{{default}}” whenever you like.
rysmoMemory.renameSuggestionsLabel: A few names to start from
rysmoMemory.renameErrorEmpty: Give it a name, or go back to the default one.
rysmoMemory.renameErrorTooLong: {{max}} characters at most — beyond that the name no longer fits in the tab bar.
rysmoMemory.toastRenameError: The name could not be saved. Try again.
rysmoMemory.clearWhyAll: There's no line-by-line removal, and that's a constraint rather than an oversight: the summary is regenerated on the server from your exchanges. Removing one line would bring it back at the next summary — a button that promises to forget without forgetting is worth less than no button. Clearing everything also deletes the exchanges, so the line doesn't return.
